column1: # Hand-written translation facts, merged over the generated rows of shader_facts.tsv by dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py: key <TAB> facts JSON (same format)
# Texture slots 18-20 hold KTGL's lighting tables, texture buffers (the eye layer's pixel shader c57860cc962189e9 reads them): the machine code has no type for them, so the
# translator read each 1D integer fetch there as 2D rows of 16384 texels, which the Android host cannot bind over a buffer (a dummy: white, noisy eyes on Byleth in close-ups).
# The other slots read that way (0-4, 16, 17, 29-31) held texture buffers too wherever the host saw them bound (its red line below), so every such slot gets

# the answer "buffer" (a texel buffer), except where the host saw an image bound (compute shader 6797af67f88a4ddd's slot 1: a 2D texture). The host logs a red line for a slot answered "buffer" that meets an image,
# and for a 2D-rows slot that meets a texture buffer (gfx_vk_exec_descriptors.inc), with the row to add
